Two Nations Ally with Saudi Arabia Against Houthi Attacks

Two nations have allied with Saudi Arabia to counter Houthi rebels, with a large plan reportedly in place to encircle them. In a related development, Houthi rebels launched a significant attack on two airports in Saudi Arabia, resulting in three injuries.
